questions.instructions: The picture_select question type uses images as the selectable options themselves. Pick whichever you'd rather look at. This default layout wraps the images in a centered row.
Same options with auto_resize: true — both images render at the same height (the smallest natural height in the group), so the row lines up neatly.
With vertical: true the images stack in a centered column. auto_resize here matches every image's width to the smallest natural width. (Integer values are stored as an integer column automatically.)
